notes.title: They Came From The Sky 2 is Out of Early Access!
notes.content:
I'm really excited to announce that They Came From The Sky 2 is Out of Early Access!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26940807/e1c3797a80e8fd136e2bb5f153c8e18c9db97aa9.png
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2080010/They_Came_From_the_Sky_2/

Thanks much to everyone who was supporting TCFTS2 during the Early Access. Thanks for all your suggestions and feedback, you're all awesome!

And special thanks to my lovely wife Silvia for her GREAT patience :)

I will continue to gather your suggestions to improve the game. If anyone has good ideas about what they'd like to see, I'd love to hear them. :)


Have fun, folks!

@FobTi

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - May 17, 2018
notes.content:
The following updates have been implemented:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26940807/7069d567b1749496b638dbd431c47e3d55070a6e.png

Added: "Civilian Killed" to the Stats

Added: Special abilities to some of the hats in the shop.
From now, your hat will be not only the ordinary fashion accessory :)

Added: Description text for the hats.

Fireman Helmet: You can walk through flames
Top Hat: Enemies drop more money
Police Cap: You start with bullet proof vest.
Robocop: Enable Burst mode for your default weapon (pistol)
Holy Pope Hat: Civilians will be imunne against your fire
Chef's Hat: Chance to drop Big Donut (restore 3 HP)
Cowboy Hat: You can fire 2x faster with your default weapon (pistol)
Batman Mask: The little bat will be your new brother in arms.
Frankenstein: Enables BlackWhite retro mode like in old movies.
Pumpkinhead: Unlock Halloween mode

Added (fixed) F12 key to take Screenshots


 Enjoy the game! 

ps. And don't forget, I'm working on a new game called "Gunman Tales" !

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - October 17, 2017
notes.content:
The HALLOWEEN update is here!

This is a limited time event (October 17 - November 1)
Get that unique Achievements, Hats and Weapons before the event is ended!

The following updates have been implemented:

Added 4 New Achievements
Mr. Pumpkin
Candyman
Witch Summoner
Ghostbuster

The option to unlock these four achievements will be unavailable after November 1!

Added 3 New Hats
Pumpkin head
Batman
Frankenstein

Added New Weapon (power-up)
The Witch
Grab the witch hat and see... :)

Added Pumpkins and Candies
Pumpkin = score +5
Candy = score +3

Added Ghosts
Catch them all! :D

Added more ammo for Freeze Gun :)

Fixed / Changed the score system
Now, if you die and use continue, the score will be reset.

Fixed "Retro TV" mode
(wrong screen stretched)



Enjoy the Halloween! Enjoy the game!

ps. I'm working on a new game called "Gunman Tales" :) Stay tuned!

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - February 25, 2017
notes.content:
The following updates have been implemented:

Just a small update this time, but may be a very important update for someone :)

Added +3 lives on the Thumbsucker difficulty.
Now you have 6 lives on the start (3 hearts), but if enemy hits you each hit takes only half heart.

Added option to fire with Left and Right bumper on XBox 360 Controller.
Thanks to Titomosquito187 for the great support and ideas. :)


Enjoy the game!

ps. I'm working on a new game :) Stay tuned!

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - December 8, 2016
notes.content:
The following updates have been implemented:

Added: Headgear Shop! ːsteamhappyː
You wanna be a Fireman, Doctor or maybe a Viking?? Just visit our new shop!

Fixed: Flamethrower on Thumbsucker difficulty.
You can kill civilians without sanction with this weapon.

Added: Collision zone for enemy van (Car Chase stage)
Please drive carefully!

Fixed: Occasional bug at the very end of stage 2 (chinatown)
Sometimes wasn't possible to complete this stage.

Fixed: Occasional bug in two player game.
Sometimes, the player 2 wasn't able to use "B" button on gamepad.

Fixed: Combo King Achievement

Changed: Mouse cursor is now hidden by default.
This game does not support mouse :O

Fixed: Enemy AI
From now, enemies can follow you everywhere.
There was one terrible bug... Thanks to "RIEo" for bug report! :)

Enjoy this update! :)

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - November 28, 2016
notes.content:
The following updates have been implemented:

Added: Difficulty Settings

ThumbSucker: +75% more damage for primary weapon, -15% speed for enemy bullets, +9 grenades on start, You can kill civilians without sanction.

Normal: +50% more damage for primary weapon, +5 grenades on start

Nuck Chorris: Your primary weapon have normal damage, You start without Bullet Proof Vest, Enemies have +1 HP

Added:Automatic save after each stage.
In the main menu, you can choose New Game or Continue.

Added: New Achievement ThumbSucker
Finish the game on the ThumbSucker difficulty.


Enjoy the game! :)
